subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Maharashtra.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Mumbai (Summer), Nagpur (Winter). Maharashtra covers a geographic area of 307,713 sq km across 36 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Godavari (Trimbakeshwar), Krishna (Mahabaleshwar), Bhima, Tapi, Wainganga.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's largest state economy. Mumbai is India's financial capital. Home to the Maratha Empire under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, Ajanta & Ellora caves, and Lonar impact crater lake.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Maharashtra.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Maharashtra was formally instituted on 1 May 1960. Official language(s): Marathi (Classical Language).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Lavani, Koli dance, Dhangari Gaja, Lezim, Povada.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Ganeshotsav (celebrated grandly statewide), Gudi Padwa, Pola.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Maharashtra.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is C. P. Radhakrishnan.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Maharashtra is Devendra Fadnavis.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Bombay High Court (Mumbai).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Indian giant squirrel (Shekru) | State Bird: Yellow-footed green pigeon (Hariyal) | State Flower: Jarul (Pride of India) | State Tree: Mango.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Maharashtra.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal (Nagpur-Chandrapur), Manganese, Bauxite, Iron Ore.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Maharashtra plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Maharashtra.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Ajanta Caves (UNESCO), Ellora Caves (UNESCO, Kailash Temple), Gateway of India, CSMT Railway Terminus, Raigad Fort.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Chandoli, Gugamal, Navegaon.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Maharashtra.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana, Lek Ladki Yojana, Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan.
